CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for [Legejo](https://github.com/jularboolean/legejo), a self-hosted library for EPUB books with a web reader, Kobo sync, OPDS for reading apps, KOReader progress sync, shared shelves, audiobooks and shelves federated over ActivityPub.
The templates use the official image, `slurvdjur/legejo`. For help with Legejo itself, open an issue in the [Legejo repository](https://github.com/jularboolean/legejo/issues); for the templates, in [this repository](https://github.com/jularboolean/unraid-templates/issues).
